run: 3: random phase, SPIRE agent sync_interval and server cache_reload_interval both 1 s
headline: vend_to_svid_ms: parent sends POST /delegations (t0) -> child's first Workload API answer holding the new X.509-SVID received (t3)
harness: src/experiments/vend_to_svid.py (with the parentsim modes vend-timed and svid-wait), including --jitter-s

code.state: uncommitted working tree at run time

command: cd src/experiments && CLUSTER_NAME=nhi-lab KUBECTX=kind-bench-v2s-1s TRUST_DOMAIN=lab.local uv run python3 vend_to_svid.py --trials 50 --jitter-s 5 --run-id 20261101T234407Z-vend-to-svid-random-phase-1s

jitter.why: the same uniform random 0-5 s wait before each trial as run 2, so only the two SPIRE intervals differ; 5 s spans several 1 s cycles, so the vend still lands at a random point of each cycle

cluster.kind_cluster: bench-v2s-1s (throwaway, two nodes), created for this run and deleted after it
cluster.note: the run was started without make, because make vend-to-svid re-applies the repository's SPIRE ConfigMaps (entries -> spire-agent -> spire-server)

config_changes_on_this_cluster_only.change: in the server block of the live spire-server ConfigMap: `audit_log_enabled = true` (as in runs 1 and 2) and `experimental { cache_reload_interval = "1s" }` (default 5 s); StatefulSet restarted (data on a PVC)
in the agent block of the live spire-agent ConfigMap: `experimental { sync_interval = "1s" }` (default 5 s); DaemonSet restarted

from_spire_server_audit.reading: a sync under 250 ms after the entry was created delivered it in 1 of 8 trials; one 750 ms or more after always did (8 of 8); the latest sync that missed it came 736.6 ms after creation and the earliest that delivered it 212.8 ms after. With the server's cache_reload_interval at 1 s the lag between the datastore write and agents seeing the entry fell from up to about 4.6 s (runs 1 and 2, 5 s default) to under about 1 s, consistent with that reload being the source of the lag.

anomalies: in trials 14, 40 and 42 the agent held the obtaining Workload API request open for about 0.5 s and answered it with the SVID (svid_window_ms 506-570 ms); t3 is still the moment the child held the SVID.
smoke_run: 2 trials (959.0 and 1285.0 ms) after the config change, not kept
